title: The Ice That Exhales
summary: Banquet ice sculpture of a woman melting into cigarette smoke, not water; cloth dry; waiter adjusts her a quarter inch. The Two as ice and absence.
visualArc: White linen → ice woman mid-curtsy → smoke not melt → waiter micro-adjustment → empty chair.
